models_evaluated: 4-billion-parameter LLM with gated Inference Time Intervention steering
models with more than 100 billion parameters

links.outcome: Unsupported claims (hallucination) in clinical QA grounded in EHR context
links.effect: Hallucination described as introducing information unsupported by context; the gated steering component was designed to mitigate it. No hallucination rates given in the abstract.
links.quote: Hallucination can introduce information that is unsupported by the context, while sycophancy can cause a model to abandon a previously correct answer when challenged by the user.

unlisted_practices: Gated inference-time activation steering (ITI) to reduce sycophancy under user pressure and hallucination
Behavior-specific gating so intervention applies only when needed

screen.reason: Evaluates a technical safeguard (inference-time intervention via gated activation steering applied to frozen LLMs) to mitigate hallucination and sycophancy in medical QA using EHR-grounded benchmarks.
